senses.definition_en: A net of thin threads made by a spider to trap insects.
examples: Flies get caught in the spider's web.

senses.definition_en: The World Wide Web or the Internet.
examples: You can find a lot of information on the web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
You can find a lot of information on the web.
